cases.description: Two debutants at 1500 with K = 275 / 5^0.4; a KO win moves each by K/2.
A wins, then fights again 1096 days later: pre-rating decayed 0.9^(1096/365.25) toward 1500, K from n = 1.
Tournament day: A beats B, C beats D, then A beats C, all from pre-day ratings and pre-day K; n advances by 2 after the day, so A's next bout uses n = 2.
S-DEC win scores 0.6, M-DEC win 0.8, an S-DEC loss 0.4 for the loser's side.
After two KO wins A expects > 0.6 against a debutant, so an S-DEC win (0.6) costs A points.
A favourite who draws loses points; a split draw between equals changes nothing.
An NC gives no update but counts toward n (next K uses n = 2) and restarts the decay clock (the stored rating is decayed to the NC day).
A CNC recorded as a draw and an Overturned recorded as a win give no update but count toward n; a DQ win scores 1.

P's 3rd bout is non-UFC: it counts toward n but not n_ufc_bouts. The peak is null until P's 5th UFC bout (a loss, 6th bout overall), so the higher rating before it is not the peak; a later non-UFC split win (a points loss for the favourite) still counts toward the peak.
Any Women's division -> F; catch/open weight or a missing class alone -> null; any other division -> M.

D and G are built up. A's best win is D, beaten by split decision, at D's rating going in (decayed over 335 days). A's draw with the stronger G, the NC, the CNC win and the Overturned win over G don't count, and neither does A's loss to G (G's best win is then A).
A beats two debutants (both 1500 going in); the tie goes to the more recent win (C, where A is fighter_b). B, C and D have no win: best_win_* null.
